title: Voxelization using the GPU hardware rasterizer | Alexandre Pestana
abstract: Last week I started to add a new feature to my tiled deferred renderer: voxelization using the GPU hardware rasterizer. A lot of recent techniques use a voxel grid // For now I choose to use a standard voxel grid instead of using a sparse octree

cited_by.name: GPU Mesh Voxelization via Axis-Aligned Projection
